FT: FT_params, FT_runs and FT_history evaluate the optimum, the register start and the ArduPilot default on the first 32 members of the Sobol sample and the 8 corners. The grid search, FT_grid, FT_sens and J_start use the first 16 members. The optimum is the best snapped point of FT_grid: whole m/s, whole degrees, whole percent and whole milliseconds, the values ArduPilot can take.
FT_robust and the optimum_robust row of FT_params are evaluated on the first 16 members, the ensemble of the sensitivities, and are reported only: no search, never the recommendation.
T-12 on the grid: 15 of 15 points have a three-seed spread within 1%. The winner (17 s) passes. Q_TRANSITION_MS within 2% of the best cost: 14, 15, 15.5, 16, 16.5, 17, 20 s.
basics_rec:18:17000:100: E and Q2 at the FT optimum's AIRSPEED_MIN 18 m/s, Q_TRANSITION_MS 17000 and TKOFF_THR_MAX 100 %: D is re-run at that entry speed, so E's back transition and its planned deceleration follow the recommended settings
